channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula joga aliados no ventilador
item.description: The lifting of the judicial secrecy in the Master case reignited Lula's electoral campaign, which had been tied with Flávio Bolsonaro in the polls. Without sparing allies, the president used the maneuver to reposition himself and catch his breath in the electoral race.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mostra os números de Lula e Flávio no Distrito Federal
item.description: A new Datafolha poll in the Federal District shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 40% and Lula (PT) at 32% in the first-round projection. Flávio's lead fluctuated slightly compared to the previous survey but remains within the margin of error. In the second round, Flávio holds 51% against Lula's 39%.

item.title: Como está a disputa entre Lula e Flávio no Rio de Janeiro, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: New Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in Rio de Janeiro, with 39% versus 35%. The gap is four percentage points, within a three-point margin of error. Cury rises to 5%, while Pablo Marçal does not significantly change the race.

item.title: Datafolha no DF: Flávio tem 40% e Lula, 32% no 1º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll in the Federal District shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 40% in the first round, followed by Lula (PT) with 32%. In a second-round scenario, Bolsonaro would have 51% against Lula's 39%. Ronaldo Caiado ranks third with 8%.

item.title: O prazo de Fachin para a PF apresentar informações sobre o celular de Vorcaro
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin gave the Federal Police 24 hours to provide details on the raw data from Daniel Vorcaro's phone. Ministers demanded access ahead of Tuesday's session; Mendonça claimed he never handled the original data. The dispute centers on messages exchanged between Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Os números milionários de 'Dark Horse' que Flávio Bolsonaro prometeu a Vorcaro: cachê de 'Oppenheimer', bilheteria da Zendaya
item.description: PF documents show Flavio Bolsonaro promised Vorcaro a US$4M fee for Jim Caviezel in 'Dark Horse', with US$12.3M actually paid. The budget sheet contrasts sharply with Brazilian market norms, reinforcing suspicions of financing irregularities. Fachin's order made Bank Master case files public.

item.title: Datafolha mostra Flávio à frente de Lula em São Paulo
item.description: A Datafolha poll released Saturday shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the presidential race in São Paulo. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio leads with 47% against Lula's 42%. The result signals growing Bolsonarista support in Brazil's largest electoral college.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem 49% e Lula, 41% no 2º turno no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: In Rio de Janeiro, Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula 49% to 41% in a runoff, though their ranges overlap within the 3-point margin of error. In the first round, Flávio has 39% and Lula 35%, a 4-point lead beyond the margin; the poll surveyed 1,204 voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 59,1% contra 35,2% de Lula no 2º turno no MT
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll of 1,209 voters, with a three-percentage-point margin of error, projects Flávio Bolsonaro defeating Lula in Mato Grosso's second round by 59.1% to 35.2%. Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos also lead Lula, although the Renan Santos scenario has a high share of blank, null or undeclared votes.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem 35%, Lula, 33%, e Cury, 7% no 1º turno em SP
item.description: In the first-round presidential poll for São Paulo, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 35% of intent-to-vote support, followed by Lula (PT) with 33%. Augusto Cury (Avante) rose from 3% to 7%, while Renan Santos (Missão) reached 6%; the supplied Datafolha excerpt does not identify the office in the simulated race.

item.title: Datafolha em PE: Lula lidera com 61% no 2º turno; Flávio tem 30%
item.description: According to Datafolha in Pernambuco, Lula (PT) leads with 61% over Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 30% in a potential runoff, with stable numbers compared to the previous survey. In the first round, Lula has 55% and Flávio 24% of voting intentions, with a margin of error of three percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Douglas Ruas são recebidos por filho de Garotinho em ato em Campos
item.description: Wladimir Garotinho welcomed Flávio Bolsonaro and Douglas Ruas in Campos dos Goytacazes, Rio de Janeiro, joining a PL caravan in the Norte Fluminense region. Flávio emphasized public security and food prices, while the event highlighted the political split between Wladimir and Anthony Garotinho's group.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro têm empate técnico no 2º turno em MG
item.description: In a hypothetical second round in Minas Gerais, Lula (46%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (45%) are in a statistical tie, with a 3-point margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 37% over Flávio's 35%, but the gap narrowed from six to two points compared to the previous poll.

item.title: Produtora de Dark Horse pagou R$ 136 mil em faturas de Mario Frias
item.description: Go Up Entertainment, producer of the film 'Dark Horse', paid R$136,800 in credit card bills of federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) between August and November 2025. Frias serves as screenwriter and executive producer of the film, while Go Up, based in the U.S., is the official production house. The payments surfaced during a Federal Police investigation into suspected misuse of congressional amendments, flagging potential corruption crimes involving public funds allocated to the movie.

item.title: Datafolha: mais de 80% dizem que crise no STF não alterou voto para presidente
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 85% of respondents did not change their presidential vote after the STF crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The crisis had little impact on voting intentions, with 86% keeping their decision following the request to investigate André Mendonça. The study also reveals 71% consider the STF essential to protecting democracy.

item.title: Atlético-MG aproveita ‘apagão’ do Fluminense e vence em casa pelo Brasileirão; veja os gols
item.description: Atlético-MG defeated Fluminense 3-1 at Arena MRV in the 27th round of the Brasileirão, with goals from Reinier, Cuello, and Vitão. The Galo capitalized on the opponent's disorganization in the second half to climb to seventh place with 39 points, while Fluminense remains in fourth with 45 points.

item.title: Datafolha: veja os números das pesquisas presidenciais em SP, RJ, MG, PE e DF
item.description: Datafolha polling shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in SP, RJ, and DF, while Lula (PT) leads in MG and PE in the first round. The two main candidates are statistically tied in most of the states surveyed. The study, commissioned by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo, interviewed voters between September 8 and 10 with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Avaliação positiva de Lula vai de 46% em PE a 25% em SP, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on Dec 12, 2026 shows Lula's approval ranging from 46% in Pernambuco to 25% in São Paulo among five surveyed states. In PE, 46% rate his government as good/excellent vs 31% bad/terrible; in SP the trend reverses. The survey highlights significant regional divergence in presidential approval.

item.title: Datafolha: Maioria dos eleitores afirma que crise no STF não muda a intenção de voto
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 80% of voters see the Supreme Court crisis as irrelevant to their presidential voting intentions, despite the clash between justices Moraes and Mendonça in the Master Case. The conflict, involving allegations of partiality and investigations into Banco Master contracts, did not affect the electoral preference of 85% regarding Moraes and 86% regarding Mendonça. The dispute was weaponized by figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula, intensifying political polarization.

item.title: Lula se queixa a aliados de ministro da Justiça, mas descarta troca no momento
item.description: President Lula has complained about Justice Minister Wellington Silva's ineffectiveness amid a crisis involving the STF, PGR, and PF, but does not intend to replace him at this time.

item.title: Datafolha no DF: Flávio Bolsonaro, 40%; Lula, 32%; Caiado; 8%; Cury, 6%; Renan, 3%; Zema, 1%
item.description: Datafolha released a poll in the Federal District showing Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 40%, followed by Lula at 32% in the projected first round. Ronaldo Caiado (8%) and Augusto Cury (6%) round out the top. In a second-round scenario, Bolsonaro leads with 51% against Lula’s 39%.

item.title: Crítica: Pedro Sampaio passa piseiro, reggaeton, brega, house music e sertanejo pelo filtro do funk em baile no Rock in Rio
item.description: Pedro Sampaio took over the Rock in Rio main stage with a wild blend of funk, reggaeton, brega and house music, delivering a contagious dance party. The high-energy performance, full of intense choreography and direct audience interaction, solidified him as one of Brazil's top musical talents.

item.title: Sem Lula, Brics assina declaração que condena tarifas unilaterais
item.description: At the Brics summit in India, heads of state signed the New Delhi Declaration, condemning unilateral trade tariffs and advocating for a stronger WTO. President Lula, amid an election campaign, did not attend the meeting, represented instead by Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, as Brazil faces U.S. sanctions under Section 301.

item.title: Master sem sigilo: saiba o que há em cada documento
item.description: STF minister André Mendonça lifted the seal on 15 procedures related to the Banco Master investigations, releasing 25.3 GB of documents, videos and audios. The measure, requested by president Edson Fachin, anticipates the analysis on the inclusion of Alexandre de Moraes in the Daniel Vorcaro investigations. The content includes information on credit portfolio fraud between Banco Master and BRB, and an alleged coordinated defense project for Vorcaro on social media.

item.title: Datafolha em PE: Lula, 55%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 24%; Cury, 4%; Renan, 2%; Caiado; 2%
item.description: Datafolha poll in Pernambuco shows Lula leading with 55% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 24%. Other candidates like Cury and Renan have less support. The inclusion of Pablo Marçal does not significantly change the scenario.

item.title: Vôlei feminino: Brasil vence 4º jogo e encara Argentina por vaga olímpica no domingo
item.description: The Brazilian women's volleyball team defeated Chile 3-0 and advanced to the South American Pre-Olympic final against Argentina, facing them at noon on Sunday with an Olympic spot on the line. Leading the tournament with 12 points, Brazil needs one win to secure a place at the 2028 Los Angeles Games.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': produção esperava bilheteria recorde de US$ 100 milhões no Brasil
item.description: A business plan found on ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone projected box office earnings of up to $100 million (~R$509M) for the film 'Dark Horse', surpassing previous records. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) confirmed requesting funds for the production, denying public funding. The projection suggests even the most conservative scenario would surpass historical box office records in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio lidera com 47% ante 42% de Lula em SP, aponta Datafolha; MG tem empate
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 47% of voting intentions against Lula's (PT) 42% in São Paulo, according to Datafolha. In Minas Gerais, there is a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: PGR reitera pedido de acesso integral de ministros a dados do caso Master
item.description: The PGR reiterated its request for the Supreme Court ministers to have full access to Daniel Vorcaro's phone data, ahead of the Master case hearing. The move aims to ensure transparency and deepen the judicial review of relevant content. The hearing is scheduled for Tuesday (15).

item.title: Datafolha em MG: Lula, 37%; Flávio 35%, Cury, 5%; Zema, 5%; Caiado, 3%
item.description: A Datafolha poll in Minas Gerais shows Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%, maintaining a technical tie in the presidential race. Other candidates have lower support, with Cury and Zema at 5% each.

item.title: Jaques Wagner se recusou a fornecer senhas de celulares à PF
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) refused to hand over passwords for two cellphones seized by the PF in Bahia during Phase 9 of Operation Compliance Zero. The PF obtained a ruling from STF Minister André Mendonça to make the report public.

item.title: Datafolha em SP: Flávio Bolsonaro, xx%; Lula, xx%; Cury, x%; Renan, x%; Caiado, x%; Zema, x%
item.description: A Datafolha poll in São Paulo measures first-round voting intentions for Brazil's 2026 presidential election, listing Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Ricardo Cury, Renan, Caiado and Zema among the candidates. The survey interviewed 1,610 voters from September 8 to 10, with a 2-percentage-point margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha: 76% dizem que ministros do STF têm poder demais
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on September 12, 2026, shows that 76% of Brazilians believe Supreme Court justices have too much power, while 77% trust the institution less than in the past. The STF crisis intensified with the disclosure of a Federal Police report on the Master Bank case, involving messages exchanged between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Justice Alexandre de Moraes, with the full court set to decide on next steps.

item.title: Michelle participa de carreata com apoiadores em Ceilândia (DF)
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro joined a rally in Ceilândia alongside Celina Leão, the incumbent DF governor candidate. She held banners supporting Flávio Bolsonaro without directly mentioning his candidacy. Michelle leads the Senate race in DF with 26% in polls.

item.title: Lula cita 4 “inimigos” da segurança em novo programa eleitoral
item.description: Lula will use his electoral ad to denounce traffickers, women abusers, cellphone thieves and crime bosses as public security’s “enemies.” The spot will also highlight the Public Security Constitutional Amendment, expansion of the Safe Cellphone program, adaptation of 138 prisons and the retaking of areas controlled by criminal groups.

item.title: PGR volta a pedir acesso de ministros a conteúdo do celular de Vorcaro
item.description: The PGR renewed its request for all Supreme Court justices to access the full content of Daniel Vorcaro's phone messages, just days before the Alexandre de Moraes case analysis. The petition aims at full transparency of the extracted chats.

item.title: Caso Master: Haddad defende fim de sigilo e critica "vazamentos seletivos"
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) called for an end to selective leaks of investigations before the 2026 elections, urging the STF to make politically relevant inquests fully public. The candidate cited the Caso Master and argued that partial disclosure favors political groups. The statement was made during the launch of his healthcare government plan.

item.title: Cachê de Jim Caviezel como Bolsonaro próximo ao de Joaquin Phoenix em 'Coringa': os valores pedidos por Flávio a Vorcaro para fazer 'Dark Horse'
item.description: The production of Dark Horse, a biopic starring Jair Bolsonaro, sees a proposed fee of US$4 million for Jim Caviezel as excessive compared to Joaquin Phoenix's US$4.5 million paycheck for portraying the Joker. Brazilian producers and directors surveyed by BBC News Brasil criticize the pricing gap between domestic political biopics and global blockbusters, highlighting misaligned commercial and cultural valuations.

item.title: PGR reforça pedido para que todos os ministros do STF tenham acesso ao conteúdo do celular de Vorcaro
item.description: The PGR reiterated its request for all STF ministers to access full case data before ruling. Fachin denied a joint session to analyze Moraes and Mendonça, keeping separate timelines. The case involves Vorcaro's phone content and messages exchanged with judges.

item.title: Zema é surpreendido e acaba no colo de apoiadora durante campanha em MG
item.description: During a campaign event in Sete Lagoas, a supporter surprised Romeu Zema by lifting him into her arms before setting him down; he reacted with surprise and laughter. Zema also met members of the “As Independentes” riding group, advocated greater female participation in politics and highlighted his state government’s support for agribusiness.

item.title: 'Graças a Deus o sigilo foi afastado', diz Flávio, que pede liberação de inquérito de Lulinha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that the lifting of the seal on investigations regarding the film 'Dark Horse', related to former President Jair Bolsonaro, will not impact his presidential campaign. He celebrated the removal of the secrecy and requested the release of the investigation involving his son, Lulinha.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio lidera em quase todas as faixas de renda, exceto entre os mais pobres, que tendem a Lula
item.description: According to Datafolha, Flávio Bolsonaro leads in nearly all income brackets except among the poorest, who favor Lula. In the overall race, there is a technical tie with Lula at 39% and Flávio at 35%, while income, religion, gender, and age differences define each candidate's voter base.

item.title: Janja é interrompida e apoiadores reagem em sua defesa com o dedo do meio
item.description: Janja was interrupted by opponents during Lula’s rally in Curitiba, prompting supporters to respond by raising middle fingers. She condemned attacks she described as misogynistic and criticized Lula’s imprisonment, without naming Sergio Moro, whom Lula also attacked during the event.

item.title: Lula: Trump sabe que eu já falei para ele não se meter nas eleições do Brasil
item.description: Lula stated that he has already spoken with Trump to prevent any American interference in Brazil's 2026 elections. The president and reelection candidate said on Saturday that the US president knows he has been warned on the matter. The statement highlights diplomatic tensions between the two countries over electoral sovereignty.

item.title: Desembargador esclarece acusação de Grass sobre julgamento no TRE-DF
item.description: Desembargador Roberval Belinati clarified candidate Leandro Grass's accusation of being prejudiced in a TRE-DF ruling. Belinati stated he did not vote in the conviction since he only presided over the session and denied ever attempting to harm any litigant. The ruling was later overturned by the TSE, which unanimously absolved Grass.

item.title: “É preciso parar com essa babaquice de fazer superavit”, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the government should not prioritize a fiscal surplus, advocating public investments to spur economic growth and reduce public debt, blaming the deficit on high interest rates. He also pledged to allocate oil revenues from the Equatorial Margin to education, science, technology, and healthcare.

item.title: Flávio diz que quebra de sigilo no caso Dark Horse tem “impacto zero”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro said that lifting secrecy in cases linked to Banco Master and the “Dark Horse” film has “zero impact,” citing the absence of new allegations as evidence of his integrity. He also demanded disclosure of the INSS and Lulinha cases, alleging that Lula’s government and the Supreme Court are trying to cover them up. The probes into the senator concern possible money laundering, capital flight and corruption crimes.

item.title: Caso Master: A arte de tentar se dar bem mesmo sendo culpado
item.description: The text examines how figures involved in the Master Case use persuasion techniques described by Schopenhauer to protect themselves and divert attention from accusations. Moraes, Flávio Bolsonaro, and other judiciary members are portrayed as part of an obfuscation strategy, attacking accusers instead of addressing facts. The author criticizes this stance, arguing that truth should prevail regardless of the political tactics employed.

item.title: 9ª cidade mais competitiva do Brasil com menos de 200 mil moradores: o município catarinense que lidera o estado em qualidade da educação e transparência
item.description: Jaraguá do Sul, in Santa Catarina, ranks as Brazil's 9th most competitive city with fewer than 200k residents, excelling in education quality and public transparency. The municipality enters the 2026 ranking leading its state in public management, outperforming state capitals and challenging the notion that only large centers deliver good governance. The piece highlights efficient public administration as a competitive edge for smaller cities.

item.title: O recado de Lula aos Bolsonaro sobre Vorcaro: ‘Eles pegaram um agiota e transformaram em banqueiro’
item.description: Lula claimed at a rally in Curitiba that the Bolsonaro family turned loan shark Daniel Vorcaro into a banker during the Bolsonaro administration, while his own government arrested and closed Banco Master. He also cited INSS fraud schemes hatched under the previous administration, involving the 'Careca do INSS' and Flávio Bolsonaro, reinforcing his narrative that corruption is a Bolsonarist legacy.
